description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of rebase operations in a Git repository. It defines several test cases to simulate rebasing on top of many unrelated changes, with and without the split-index feature, using functions sourced from an external script.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or sets up the default repository environment for performance tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that must succeed, specifying setup commands and actions.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for use in loop iterations or data generation.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates advancing the clock or performing a timestamp update within the test.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified files and messages.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified commands or operations.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
